summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and the `EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum)` class with eleven commented members. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made the STS predicate accept endpoint_config=None (treated as no variant tags); added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults with the specified keyword parameters. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion, including the S3 predicate call-count test and exactly one custom-data and one bundled-data SDK endpoint test. Verification: tests/unit/test_args.py passes (59 tests); test_regions.py, test_client.py, and test_endpoint.py also pass (443 passed across the four files). Nothing is committed. Limitations: black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand only; one pre-existing line in args.py (line 315) exceeds 79 columns and was left alone.
